limitations: Route discovery covers literal path-equality dispatch blocks and the methods declared within them. Regex-expanded project/document routes, VERSION_PATHS arrays, auth-provider catchalls, module contributions, and runtime-composed routes remain for #671.

Tool discovery covers literal server.tool names in the listed MCP module. Other registration modules, enabled-action expansion, and runtime-composed tools remain for #671; dynamic names in this scope fail closed.

SQL discovery covers named top-level tables, functions, triggers, indexes, and ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT declarations in the listed initial migration. Other migrations, inline table constraints, and runtime-generated objects remain for #671; unsupported DDL fails closed.
